description: This file defines the 'ProxyInterfaceDescription' class within the 'Orleans.CodeGenerator' namespace. It appears to be responsible for describing proxy interfaces in the Orleans code generation framework, including method analysis, validation, and associated diagnostics. The class encapsulates the representation and validation logic for proxy interface types used in Orleans grain interfaces.

classes.name: ProxyInterfaceDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a proxy interface, including methods, namespace, type parameters, and validation logic within the Orleans code generation context.

methods.name: GetMethods
methods.description: Retrieves all non-explicit interface methods from the interface and its base interfaces, excluding explicitly implemented methods.

methods.name: ValidateBaseClass
methods.description: Validates that the specified base class conforms to expected method signatures for InvokeAsync. Throws an exception if validation fails.
